purpose: Validate the C++ RDS provider against a real Windows Server guest.
doesNotProve: independent ownership of host monitors or input devices
hardware graphics acceleration or application compatibility

requiredFor: official evaluation media and its applicable license terms

guest.activationAndUpdateNetworkPlan: pending; baseline has no guest outbound access

requirements: Check free space before provisioning, starting, importing media and creating snapshots.
Account for all laboratory files, not only the qcow2 disk.
Monitor remaining space and stop guest writes before the 25 GiB floor is reached.
Fail closed if monitoring or stopping writes cannot be confirmed.
Do not claim an absolute free-space guarantee against unrelated host applications.

machineProposal.firmware: UEFI; compatible firmware files must be verified before provisioning
machineProposal.storageInterface: emulated NVMe; guest boot compatibility not yet tested
machineProposal.graphics: emulated standard VGA; no host GPU passthrough

launchBlockers: explicit resource and license approval is pending
official media and guest preparation are pending
QEMU dependencies, firmware and guest compatibility are unverified
activation and updates require a separately agreed network plan
disk growth guard is not implemented or validated
